evidence: Three chain cases added: a later closeout for the right digest that the validator rejects does not bind and is listed as rejected; an untracked closeout in the landing tree is refused with the uncommitted-changes error before any round is bound; the unbound round's candidate hash printed at its own base after the retro ledger landed equals the hash printed before it existed.

scan, validator_accepts and candidate_scope are unchanged by this round; bind_candidate only chooses which tree scan enumerates, and the single-ledger and manifest paths keep the checkout as that tree.
Fixed in the landing candidate; the succession challenge on that candidate is the final receipt of this closeout.
